title: Embedding Arithmetic: A Lightweight, Tuning-Free Framework for Post-hoc Bias Mitigation in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from text prompts of various professions (e.g., "A photo portrait of a CEO"), classifying the gender of the faces in the generated images using a ResNet-based attribute detector trained on the FairFace dataset, and computing the Shannon Entropy of the resulting gender distribution.

Generating images from text prompts of various professions, classifying the racial category of the generated faces (white, black, asian, indian) using a ResNet-based attribute detector trained on the FairFace dataset, and computing the Shannon Entropy of the racial distribution.
